repairs.cause: Fake native scalar observations lacked the new actual-source counters; probe failed before intended question/timeout behavior.
repairs.fix: Provide zero actual-source observations for fixtures deliberately producing no audio; retain all acceptance and timeout checks.

repairs.cause: Shared synthetic worker page used insecure about:blank, where the no-PLC receiver cannot create its secure APIs.
repairs.fix: Serve only the exact local fixture document through an in-memory HTTPS route, retaining the general network abort route.

repairs.cause: Sub-second capture-duration fixtures could stop before browser setup or the RX observation being asserted.
repairs.fix: Explicitly stop after observed scoped PCM and TX/restore observations; preserve bounded failure waits and stopped-source semantics.

repairs.cause: A fixed 200ms point measurement could miss the short resumed waveform under full-suite load.
repairs.fix: Use existing receiver-side finite tone-observation window started before the 300ms input; verify actual 440Hz level and unchanged sender track.
